substeps.label: B4 · close up and inert
substeps.caption: Close the door and purge to the O₂ setpoint. The gas flows across the plate from the inlet to the outlet; the direction drawn here is assumed, so note the real one.

substeps.label: B5 · recoat one layer
substeps.caption: One layer: the build platform drops one layer thickness and the recoater spreads powder over the plate and the inserts; the excess falls into the overflow.

substeps.label: B5 · expose (slowed down)
substeps.caption: The laser draws each track once, every track in the same direction, starting on the gas-outlet side so spatter lands on finished tracks rather than on fresh powder.

substeps.label: B5 · 72 tracks
substeps.caption: 72 tracks: one full replicate (16 power–speed sets and 2 controls) on each insert, in random positions, so the four inserts are four replicates and position effects can be measured. The exposure takes seconds; the whole step is under 15 minutes.
